title: A switch in the parts list the walk cannot reach
goal: One of the scripted walks that checks the right hand panel stops partway through: it tries to press a switch in the Appearance list and the switch has scrolled out of reach, so the rest of that walk never runs and nothing after step 54 is being checked any more.
notes:
Pre-existing, NOT caused by the Appearance section gate change on 2026-09-08. Reproduced both ways.

WITH that change: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/parts-settings-inline-walk.json --no-build -> exit 1, [54 press] FAILED: the control "Switch" is not where a person could click it: it is off the window, or the dock has scrolled it far enough that the panel's edge cuts across the point a press would land on. Scroll to it with a "scrollPanel" step first.

WITHOUT it (git stash push -- Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift, full rebuild): identical failure at step 54, same message. So the gate change is not the cause.

Likely the same class as the alignment-button task that landed on 2026-09-08 (44d95ca0 "Scroll to the alignment buttons instead of guessing a distance"): the walk needs a scrollPanel step rather than a guessed distance.
acceptance: The walk reaches the switch the way a person would rather than by assuming where the panel sits
